questions.question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.**

He continued staring at the elephant, as if he had not see one before.

options.text: as if he had not see

questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'as if he had not see'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'as if he had not seen'** should be used instead of **'as if he had not see'.**
 
• In the given sentence the** second clause** is in the** past perfect tense**. As we know that after 'had' third form of the verb is used. So, the verb '**see**', the** first form** should be changed into the **third form**, ' **seen**'.
 
 
• *Example: I** had finished** the work.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He continued staring at the elephant, as if he had not seen one before.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option fill in the blank.**

I have been studying this course _______ two years now.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate preposition for the given blank is '**for**'.
 
• The word '**for**' is used to show a period of time, in the **past, present, or future.**
 
• The given sentence is in the present **perfect continuous tense.**
 
 
• ***​**Example: I have been reading War and Peace for a month now. *
 
 The word '**since**' is used to refer to a time (an action that began in the past and is still continuing). It is used as a preposition.
 
• So, '**for**' should be used here.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I have been studying this course **for** two years now.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• **Through **- Incorrect here because "**through**" indicates movement within a time period, e.g., "through the night," but not for indicating a duration of time.
 
• **Since **- Incorrect because "**since**" specifies the starting point of an action or event, e.g., "since 2022," not a duration.
 
• **Almost **- Incorrect because "**almost**" implies an approximation but does not specify the exact time frame, e.g., "almost two years."

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice**

This match is being watched today by more than thirty-three million people worldwide.

options.text: This match is watching more than thirty-three million people worldwide today.
More than thirty-three million people worldwide have been watching this match today.
More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.
Today more than thirty-three million people worldwide have watched this match.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change the sentence into Active Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject(Objective Case)+ is/am/are + being + V3+ by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
 
 
• Here, in the given question 'are being watched' will be changed into 'are watching'. 
 
• 'By' will be removed.
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is Option 3. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *More than thirty-three million people worldwide are watching this match today.*

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The current concern is that it is rising day by day due to various resources of pollutants.

B. It has been there in different forms since a long time, even before human evolution, such as volcanic eruptions, wildfire which led to various photochemical reactions in the atmosphere.

C. Pollution has become a very common yet serious issue in today’s world.

D. And, one of the main pollutants are humans and man-made machines.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**CBAD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence C will be the first statement because it is a general independent statement and it is talking about the common problem of **pollution**.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence as it further tells us about the time this problem is prevalent. 
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because it is telling us about the current situation of pollution.
 
• Lastly, Sentence D will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• C: Pollution has become a very common yet serious issue in today’s world.
 
• B: It has been there in different forms since a long time, even before human evolution, such as volcanic eruptions, wildfire which led to various photochemical reactions in the atmosphere.
 
• A: The current concern is that it is rising day by day due to various resources of pollutants.
 
• D: And, one of the main pollutants are humans and man-made machines.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

Correct Sequence:__ *Pollution has become a very common yet serious issue in today’s world. It has been there in different forms since a long time, even before human evolution, such as volcanic eruptions, wildfire which led to various photochemical reactions in the atmosphere. The current concern is that it is rising day by day due to various resources of pollutants. And, one of the main pollutants are humans and man-made machines.*

**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The finance minister will announce the budget.

options.text: The budget will have announced by the finance minister.
The budget were announced by the finance minister.
The budget are announced by the finance minister.
The budget will be announced by the finance minister.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The budget will be announced by the finance minister'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The finance minister'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the budget'. 
 
• Since a modal verb has been used in the active voice, therefore, the passive voice will follow the given structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - **Subject** + modal verb*(will) *+ V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice - **Object(Subjective form)** modal verb*(will)* + be + V3 Subject (Objective form).
 
 
 
• Here, 'will announce' is changed into 'will be annunced' because in the 'active to passive' transformation **third form of the verb** is used. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *The budget will be announced by the finance minister.*
